Partition selected positions into r nonempty blocks sharing an operation; a block contributes its smallest position divided by n. Scan positions increasingly: taking a constant contributes a_j; joining one of r existing blocks contributes r*v without changing its minimum; opening a block contributes j*v. Thus dp_j[r]=(a_j+r*v)*dp_previous[r]+j*v*dp_previous[r-1]. Finally assign distinct operation labels via the falling factorial(m)_r and divide by n^r. Truncate only mathematically impossible r>m, not model input or answers.
